vīderam

vīderam, fēceram, amāveram

the pluperfect tense: no auxiliary

I had seen, done, loved

In this lexicon

  • had

    the recommended word · classical · Plin. Ep. 8.20.3: quod nec audieram ante nec vīderam; Liv. 40.21.2: cupīdō eum cēperat in verticem Haemī montis ascendendī
